notes: "This is the feature I consider most important. History is kept per page, not for the whole deck. Right-click a slide in the Pages panel and choose View version history. Saved versions are the milestones I name myself, like Before copy edit. Operation history lists every saved change to that page, each with its review. And restoring a version changes only that slide; every other slide, and every talk that uses them, stays as it is. This is what replaces the folder of copies from the beginning of the talk."

designIntent.purpose: Explain named versions, operation history and single-slide restore.
keep: Markers must not hide the UI element they point to
designIntent.requestedChange: Story-driven rework: organise the founder's reasons for building HUANDENG and show the features that answer them.
